text:
ash: Heads up — noticed a bunch of GPU model shard syncs failing in eu-west this morning, high inter-node packet loss and KV lag. pods on node-pool-gpu-1 -> node-pool-gpu-2 showing 20-40% loss :facepalm:
maria: any recent networkpolicy changes? could be namespace-level egress lock-down again
ash: @maria yes, pushed a restrictive netpol to namespace `ml-serving` ~2:30am to tighten egress to external services (blocked outbound except to a few CIDRs)
sam: hmm that kind of policy can implicitly drop overlay traffic if we don't allow node/agent addr ranges. Are we blocking IPIP/VXLAN encapsulation?
ash: I ran `tcpdump -i vxlan0` and saw a lot of `ICMP frag needed` and repeated retransmits. tracepath between two gpu pods shows MTU clamping at 1500 and DF=1 errors.
calico-bot: Detected dropped packets matching IP-in-IP protocol between nodes 10.12.3.0/24 and 10.12.4.0/24, policy-match: ns/ml-serving/netpol/egress-restrict-2026-03-17
jordan: can you paste the netpol yaml? maybe an accidental `to: { ipBlock: ... }` without allowing node-to-node?
ash: snippet:
```yaml
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-restrict-2026-03-17
  namespace: ml-serving
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 172.16.0.0/12
          ports:
            - protocol: TCP
              port: 443
```
ash: I missed node CIDRs and the encapsulation proto. Calico uses IP-in-IP (protocol 4) in this cluster for cross-node overlay. The netpol above implicitly blocked that because it only allowed TCP/443 to that CIDR.
maria: that would explain fragmentation too — overlay headers push packets over node MTU and if encapsulation is dropped you get DF=1 ICMPs and fatal packet loss for large messages (GPU KV syncs use big chunks).
sam: quick fix: add an egress rule allowing all traffic to the node CIDRs and allow protocol 4 (IPIP) or allow traffic to the calico/node DaemonSet. Example:
```yaml
- to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.12.0.0/16  # node CIDR
  ports: []
- to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: calico-node
```
ops: Patch applied to ml-serving netpol to allow node CIDR and calico nodes, rolling out now.
infra-bot: Patch verified on 3 nodes, packet drops dropped to <1%, kv-sync latency back to baseline in canary pool :tada:
jordan: follow-up: file a small policy template for namespaces that need tight egress but still allow overlay/agent health. Also add a preflight `kubectl jp` check for netpols that would block node CIDRs or protocol 4.
maria: opened ticket INFRA-3482 with template & presubmit check. Assigning to networking.
ash: thanks all. leaving the thread here but will monitor canaries for 30m. :eyes:
